title: Broil King — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Broil King.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Rule the Flame." Broil King is made by Onward Manufacturing in Waterloo, Ontario — a Canadian grill company since 1986. Their patented Flav-R-Wave cooking system vaporizes drippings for smoky flavor without flare-ups. Broil King offers premium stainless construction at prices well below Napoleon and Weber Summit.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget-premium outdoor cooking. Canadian buyers wanting domestic manufacturing. Customers who want stainless at a fair price.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Broil King:

• Flav-R-Wave system creates smoky flavor without flare-ups

• Canadian-made in Waterloo, Ontario

• Heavy-duty stainless at prices below Napoleon and Weber Summit

• Dual-tube burners provide even heat across the entire cooking surface

• Strong dealer network across Canada
